name: Tethered Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus pass control of non-Ritual spells to others or tether spells to objects; all their spells become arcane connections to them.

name: Vis Sensitivity
description: Major Heroic Virtue allowing a character to sense raw vis by touch, gauge its pawns and identify its Art.

name: Magic Sensitivity
description: Virtue that may be taken free with Vis Sensitivity, at a penalty to Magic Resistance.

name: Bound Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw: when the magus dies, all their spells end and magic items they created cease to function.

name: Fettered Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw: all the magus's spells and activated item effects are arcane connections to them.

name: Hermetic Patron
description: Minor Story Flaw for a Redcap or magus watched over by an older magus or Redcap patron who grants favors but demands service.

name: Heroic Personality
description: Minor Heroic Flaw granting strong Personality traits and Confidence, but letting the storyguide sometimes dictate the character's heroic actions.

name: Illegitimate Lineage
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw for a member of House Mercere not descended by blood from Mercere, giving a poor reputation and denying House benefits.

name: Legacy
description: Minor Story Flaw: the character descends from a legendary magus or Redcap and is accorded respect but given harder tasks.

name: Pagan
description: Major Story Flaw: the character does not follow the Church and has never been baptized.

name: Tragic (Characteristic)
description: Minor Heroic Flaw imposing a specialty in a negative Characteristic that subtracts three and adds a botch die in that circumstance.

name: Usurer
description: Minor Status Flaw: the character lends at abusive interest, earning about ten pounds of silver a year but a poor reputation.

name: Mutantum Magic
description: Magical aptitude suggested as related to Bound Magic and Fettered Magic.

name: Tamed Magic
description: Virtue that may be combined with Bound or Fettered Magic to represent imperfect understanding of one's talent.

name: Harnessed Magic
description: Virtue from the core rules that already includes the effect of Bound Magic, so cannot be taken with it.

name: Heroic Virtues and Flaws
description: Category of Virtues and Flaws that Legacy characters may take if appropriate to their lineage.

name: Minor Magical Focus in Certamen
description: All Tremere magi have a Minor Magical Focus in Certamen, making them excellent duelists but limiting their power.

name: Mercurian Magic
description: Virtue whose practitioners in House Tremere mostly died in the Tempest; no longer required for membership.

name: Heir
description: Virtue that can modify a Tremere magus's relationship with his tribune or conciliarius.

name: Mentor
description: Virtue that can modify a Tremere magus's relationship with his tribune or conciliarius.

name: Close Family Ties
description: Virtue that can modify a Tremere magus's relationship with his tribune or conciliarius.

name: Entrancement
description: Virtue listed as common among Tremere magi.

name: Skilled Parens
description: Virtue listed as common among Tremere magi.

name: Piercing Gaze
description: Virtue listed as common among Tremere magi.

name: Self Confident
description: Virtue listed as common among Tremere magi.

name: Second Sight
description: Virtue listed as common among Tremere magi.

name: Social Contacts
description: Virtue listed as common among Tremere magi.

name: Cautious Sorcerer
description: Virtue listed as common among Tremere magi.

name: Temporal Influence
description: Virtue listed as common among Tremere magi.

name: Shapeshifter
description: Virtue that may explain stories about the wolves of Coeris; Tremere shapeshifters often take owl form.

name: Skinchanger
description: Virtue that may explain stories about the wolves of Coeris.

name: Visions
description: Virtue that occasionally occurs among common white wolves.

name: Gentle Gift
description: Virtue all Tremere Assessors possess.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: Virtue possessed by the ghostly cataphract.

name: Dark Secret (Diedne Magic)
description: Flaw not appropriate for Tremere characters, since the House would react violently to a druidical lineage.

name: Berserk
description: Flaw that makes magi unable to fight to doctrine and thus ineffective soldiers.

name: Hedge Wizard
description: Flaw that few Tremere magi would accept in an apprentice.

name: Faerie Upbringing
description: Flaw that few Tremere magi would accept in an apprentice.

name: Noncombatant
description: Flaw that few Tremere magi would accept in an apprentice.

name: Softhearted
description: Flaw that few Tremere magi would accept in an apprentice.

name: Reclusive
description: Flaw that few Tremere magi would accept in an apprentice.

name: Weak Parens
description: Flaw: a Weak Parens would not train a child in House Tremere.

name: Infamous
description: Flaw a Tremere master might acquire during or after an apprenticeship.

name: Tainted with Evil
description: Flaw that would prevent an apprentice from being selected for Tremere training.

name: Magic Addiction
description: Flaw that prevents a magus serving effectively; most Tremere see it as humiliating.

name: Painful Magic
description: Flaw that prevents a magus serving effectively; most Tremere see it as humiliating.

name: Fury
description: Flaw that prevents a magus serving effectively; most Tremere see it as humiliating.

name: Rigid Magic
description: Flaw that makes a Tremere magus suboptimal on the battlefield but can be hidden; a source of embarrassment.

name: Short-ranged Magic
description: Flaw that makes a Tremere magus suboptimal on the battlefield but can be hidden; a source of embarrassment.

name: Unstructured Caster
description: Flaw that makes a Tremere magus suboptimal on the battlefield but can be hidden; a source of embarrassment.

name: Careless Sorcerer
description: Flaw that makes a Tremere magus suboptimal on the battlefield but can be hidden; a source of embarrassment.

name: Slow Caster
description: Flaw that makes a Tremere magus suboptimal on the battlefield but can be hidden; a source of embarrassment.

name: Unpredictable Magic
description: Flaw that makes a Tremere magus suboptimal on the battlefield but can be hidden; a source of embarrassment.

description: Flaw that makes a Tremere magus suboptimal on the battlefield but can be hidden; a source of embarrassment.

description: Flaw that makes a Tremere magus suboptimal on the battlefield but can be hidden; a source of embarrassment.

name: Weird Magic
description: Flaw that makes a Tremere magus suboptimal on the battlefield but can be hidden; a source of embarrassment.

description: Flaw that makes a Tremere magus suboptimal on the battlefield but can be hidden; a source of embarrassment.

name: Afflicted Tongue
description: Flaw that makes a Tremere magus suboptimal on the battlefield but can be hidden; a source of embarrassment.

name: Motion Sickness
description: Flaw that makes a Tremere magus suboptimal on the battlefield but can be hidden; a source of embarrassment.

name: No Sense of Direction
description: Flaw that makes a Tremere magus suboptimal on the battlefield but can be hidden; a source of embarrassment.

name: Obese
description: Flaw that makes a Tremere magus suboptimal on the battlefield but can be hidden; a source of embarrassment.

name: Palsied Hands
description: Flaw that makes a Tremere magus suboptimal on the battlefield but can be hidden; a source of embarrassment.

name: Poor Eyesight
description: Flaw that makes a Tremere magus suboptimal on the battlefield but can be hidden; a source of embarrassment.

name: Poor Hearing
description: Flaw that makes a Tremere magus suboptimal on the battlefield but can be hidden; a source of embarrassment.

name: Clumsy Magic
description: Flaw that would cripple a Tremere magus in sagas using this chapter's dueling rules.

name: Favors
description: Flaw creating an obligation in addition to that of House membership.

name: House Mercere
description: House of the Redcaps; members not descended from Mercere by blood are considered illegitimate.

name: House Tremere
description: Hermetic House assuming a chaotic, dangerous world, organized militarily with block voting and domination of the Transylvanian Tribunal; domus magna Coeris.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House; many expected Tremere to join it; its demonically corrupted magi were fought by Tremere and Quaesitores.

name: House Diedne
description: Druidic House exterminated by House Tremere in the Schism War after accusations of human sacrifice.

name: House Bonisagus
description: House that shares useful information with the Order and whose magi aid Tremere spell research.

name: House Merinita
description: House whose fantastic powers are contrasted with Tremere material aid; collaborates with the Burning Acorn Vexillation.

name: House Criamon
description: House cited as having fantastic powers compared to Tremere material aid.

name: House Guernicus
description: House whose Primus brokered a truce between Tremere and his enemies in 848.

name: House Bjornaer
description: House whose members alone employ the Bestiarius certamen school using their Heartbeast.

name: House Flambeau
description: Founder Flambeau's House; Tremere sought to dissuade Flambeau from aggression.

name: House Verditius
description: House of item-makers contracted by Tremere to build magic items, lodged at the Covenant of Lycaneon.

name: Mercere
description: Founder of House Mercere; true Merceres are descended from him by blood.

name: Tremere
description: Founder of House Tremere, youngest and weakest Founder, developer of certamen, who tried to dominate the Order and was thwarted in the Sundering; died 862.

name: Albanus
description: Tremere's oldest student and successor, First Primus, who spoke Tremere's eulogy and founded the Broken Mirrors Vexillation.

name: Poena
description: Current Prima of House Tremere, who has funded research projects especially against Islamic wizards of the Levant.

name: Cercistum
description: Primus of Tremere at the beginning of the Schism War, killed in battle; claimed he could raise ghost armies.

name: Trianoma
description: Founder who met Guorna the Fetid in 757 and helped propagate certamen.

name: Guorna the Fetid
description: Necromancer ruling a remnant cult in Naples, parens of Tytalus and Tremere, whose followers they slaughtered.

name: Tytalus
description: Founder, fellow apprentice of Tremere under Guorna, whom Tremere sought to avoid serving.

name: Bonisagus
description: Founder who taught Tytalus and Tremere and created certamen with Tremere's aid.

name: Jerbiton
description: Founder whose nominal suzerainty was accepted by Byzantine magi resisting Tremere; helped propagate certamen.

name: Umno
description: Previous Primus of House Tremere, now governing the Burning Acorn Vexillation.

name: The Epicurean
description: Masked figure who always leads the Cold Iron Vexillation; in Arcadia a continuing entity.

name: Valerius
description: Archmagus and current Secutor of House Tremere whose mind was damaged in a faerie forest.

name: Theodoros of Tytalus
description: Rival of Valerius who intends to challenge him to certamen and then the Prima.

name: Kore
description: Fifth and only necromantic Prima of Tremere, creator of the Scythian torc, first Primus replaced by force for insanity.

name: Agrippina
description: Famous tenth-century duelist who sent white roses with challenges; nicknamed Nemesis.

name: Samuel, King of the Bulgars
description: Bulgarian king who died of shock on seeing his blinded army in 1014.

name: Asen
description: Elder of two brothers who rebelled against the Byzantine Empire in 1185, raiding Thrace and Macedonia.

name: Ivan Asen II
description: Current Tsar of Bulgaria, claiming the title Emperor of the Bulgars and Greeks, enemy of the Latins in Constantinople.

name: Isaac Angelus
description: Byzantine Emperor forced to send forces north against the Bulgarian rebellion.

name: Andrew II
description: King of Hungary whose conflicts with his nobles are being resolved; his daughter married John II in 1218.

name: John II
description: Married the daughter of Andrew II in 1218, partly due to Tremere influence.

name: Thamyris
description: Blind bard after whom amber-eyed children in Transylvania are often named.

name: King Lycurgus of Sparta
description: Spartan king whose saying 'Obedience is of the highest benefit' is a Tremere moral touchstone.

name: Xenophon
description: Classical author whose aphorisms many Tremere magi favor.

name: Orpheus
description: Mythic figure who departed into the underworld through the Gate of Eurydice.

name: Hannibal
description: Commander whose three victories over the Romans in Italy Cercistum claimed he could raise as ghosts.

name: Belisarius
description: General whose troops sacked Naples; Guorna claimed to raise the dead of that sack.

name: Justinian
description: Emperor whose sixth-century imperial adventure left cataphract ghosts in the West.

name: Aita
description: Underworld deity whose priesthood (butterfly symbol) was House Tremere's first ancestral tradition.

name: Pluto
description: God of the Underworld and hidden wealth whom Tremere's ancestors served, symbolized by the two-pronged pitchfork.

name: Mercury Psychopompos
description: Mercury as Conductor of Souls, whom Tremere's ancestors served as priests after the Cult of Mercury absorbed them.

name: Hermes
description: God to whom Tremere's white wolf pack was sacred; many Tremere refuse to swear oaths to Hermes.

name: Charon
description: Ferryman on the River Styx, after whom the Charon certamen trick is named.

name: Redcaps
description: Members of House Mercere, often unGifted messengers.

name: Quaesitores
description: Hermetic investigators; Tremere aided them against Tytalus diabolists and they watch Tremere necromancers.

name: Cult of Mercury
description: Roman cult that absorbed Tremere's ancestral necromantic tradition during Augustus's reign.

name: Necromantic cult
description: Tremere's ancestral necromantic tradition, which made lairs under cities like Naples.

name: Theban League
description: Group of Byzantine magi who resisted Tremere under Jerbiton's nominal suzerainty.

name: Dacians
description: People who ruled Transylvania before the Romans, fighting under wolf-headed dragon banners.

name: Islamic wizards
description: Mystical groups beyond the Order, especially of the Levant, whom House Tremere studies and Poena seeks to counter.

name: Abyssal Bearer Vexillation
description: Continuing Tremere vexillation ensuring no Tremere magus is left unburied; led by the eldest-by-eldest descendant of Tremere.

name: Burning Acorn Vexillation
description: Continuing Tremere vexillation of explorers seeking the leaders of House Diedne, governed by Umno.

name: Cold Iron Vexillation
description: Tremere vexillation of faerie-blooded soldier-diplomats settling faerie disputes, led by the Epicurean.

name: Broken Mirrors Vexillation
description: Vexillation founded by Albanus to investigate diabolism, treason or cowardice within House Tremere.

name: House Council
description: Council of Tremere magi holding their own sigils, meeting every ten years at Coeris; lacking formal powers since the Schism.

name: Pirates of Rhodes
description: Pirates against whom Tremere's new naval doctrine is to be tested.

name: Latins
description: Latin invaders occupying Constantinople and the Theban Tribunal.

name: Transylvanian Tribunal
description: Tribunal utterly dominated by House Tremere, stretching from the Adriatic to the Black Sea, with only five covenants.

name: Novgorod Tribunal
description: Tribunal containing the last substantial pagan populations by 1220.

name: Theban Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose covenants may have precipitated the Byzantine invasion of Bulgaria.

name: Iberian Tribunal
description: Tribunal with a large Tremere House covenant, sharing an exarch with Provencal.

name: Roman Tribunal
description: Tribunal with a large Tremere House covenant; its exarch inherits leadership if Coeris falls.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: Tribunal with a large Tremere covenant; its exarchate controls the British Tribunals and Normandy.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal supervised by its own Tremere exarch.

name: Levant Tribunal
description: Tribunal overseen with Thebes by one Tremere exarch.

name: Provencal Tribunal
description: Tribunal sharing a Tremere exarch with Iberia.

name: Normandy Tribunal
description: Tribunal in the Stonehenge-based exarchate.

name: Greater Alps Tribunal
description: Tribunal in the exarchate with Transylvania and Novgorod.

name: Grand Tribunal
description: Order-wide Tribunal that in 817 accepted certamen as decisive in all disputes.

name: Coeris
description: Domus Magna of House Tremere in the Transylvanian Alps, above the Gate of Eurydice and holding the House treasury.

name: Covenant of Lycaneon
description: Tremere covenant holding the House's amber deposits and lodging hired Verditius magi.

name: Gate of Eurydice
description: Abyss beneath Coeris through which Orpheus entered the underworld; focus of Tremere funeral practice, possibly a regio.

name: Waters of Forgetfulness
description: Waters in the funeral cavern of Coeris, harvested for vis, whose residue dyes Tremere robes and heals psychological injuries.

name: Mount Lycaeon
description: Associated with a ritual rumored to turn men into wolves for nine years.

name: Transylvania
description: Region where House Tremere is dominant.

name: Naples
description: City over a great cave complex where Guorna's necromantic cult was based.

name: Rome
description: City whose catacombs hosted early Christian churches.

name: Hades
description: The underworld, reachable via the Gate of Eurydice.

name: Bulgaria
description: Kingdom invaded by Byzantium in 1014 and later rebelling under the Asens.

name: Hungary
description: Kingdom in the Transylvanian Tribunal ruled by Andrew II.

name: Byzantine Empire
description: Eastern Empire where Tremere attacked magicians; invaded Bulgaria and Hungary.

name: Constantinople
description: Capital occupied by the Latins, coveted by Ivan Asen II.

name: Tirnova
description: Place near which the Asen brothers were minor lords.

name: Thrace
description: Region raided by Asen.

name: Macedonia
description: Region raided by Asen.

name: Epirus
description: Balkan power in 1220.

name: Nicea
description: Balkan power in 1220.

name: Croatia
description: Part of the Transylvanian Tribunal.

name: Rodopi Mountains
description: Mountains marking the southern extent of the Transylvanian Tribunal in Bulgaria.

name: Transylvanian Alps
description: Mountains where Tremere built Coeris.

name: Dacia
description: Origin of another necromantic remnant group allied to Tremere.

name: Kalkriese
description: Site of the Varus disaster skirmish where Tremere necromancers routed Diedne magi with ghosts.

name: Cape Pachynus
description: Site of the storm destroying a Roman fleet in 255 BC.

name: Cserwenitsa
description: Hungarian site of Europe's only significant opal deposits, secured by a Tremere covenant.

name: Arcadia
description: Faerie realm where the Epicurean is a continuing entity.

name: Adriatic Sea
description: Sea where the Tremere fleet is active; griffin vultures live along its coast.

name: Black Sea
description: Sea where the Tremere fleet is active.

name: Cyprus
description: Island beyond which Tremere interests may expand.

name: Rhodes
description: Island home to pirates.

name: Levant
description: Region of Islamic wizards.

name: Baltic Sea
description: Main alternative source of amber.

name: River Styx
description: Underworld river of Charon.

name: Certamen
description: Magical dueling system developed by Tremere and Bonisagus, used by House Tremere to settle disputes and mark life stages.

name: Schism War
description: War in which House Diedne was destroyed; over half of House Tremere died.

name: The Tempest
description: Decisive battle of the Schism War.

name: The Sundering
description: The 848 defeat of Tremere's plan to rule the Order, when his lieutenants' minds were broken.

name: Wizard's War
description: Sanctioned war between magi, which closely matched duelists avoid via certamen.

name: Wizards' March
description: Hermetic outlawing and hunt of a magus, which Tremere magi attend and lead.

name: Gauntlet
description: Test ending apprenticeship; for Tremere a certamen challenge between apprentice and master.

name: Sigil
description: Symbol of a magus; in House Tremere a birchwood wand held by the parens until claimed by certamen.

name: Primus
description: Leader of House Tremere, ruling for life from Coeris and appointing a successor.

name: Exarch
description: Senior Tremere magus commanding House operations in one or more Tribunals; six exist.

name: Legatus
description: Field leader of House Tremere in war and the Primus's heir.

name: Secutor
description: Tremere conciliarius who wins the right to assess the Primus's competency and may challenge the Primus.

name: Conciliarius
description: Member of the Tremere Council holding his own sigil; councilor and counselor.

name: Tribune
description: Local Tremere advocate who speaks and votes for the House at Tribunal.

name: Vexillation
description: Small Tremere squad or group given a single task, some continuing indefinitely.

name: Dragon banner
description: Enchanted wolfish dragonhead battle banner carried for each exarch.

name: Vexillation pennant
description: Pennant enchanted with useful communication and travel effects given to vexillation leaders.

name: Scythian torc
description: Torc of teeth of a Scythian chieftain and warriors, made by Kore, summoning thirty-four ghostly horsemen.

name: Skull of Guorna the Fetid
description: Relic sought by necromancers to learn Guorna's techniques.

name: Birchwood wand
description: Wand serving as a young Tremere magus's sigil, used to ignite the funeral pyre.

name: Tremere Doctrine
description: House Tremere's method of war and philosophy of living, emphasizing coordinated soldiers.

name: Block voting
description: Tremere practice of voting as a bloc at Tribunal via free proxies to the Tribune.

name: Transitionalism
description: Tremere political priority for Code changes compelling magi to assist the Order.

name: Decennial
description: Ten-yearly meeting of the Tremere Council at Coeris.

name: Ceremony of Welcome
description: Tremere ceremonies at which Housemates meet and Gauntlets are often held.

name: Peripheral Code
description: Body of Hermetic rulings Tremere seek to reform.

name: Code of Hermes
description: The Order's law protecting mundanes and faeries; summoning the damned breaches it.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic magical defense; valued by Tremere.

name: Dominion
description: Divine realm's influence, which invaded necromantic sites.

name: Divine
description: The one possible exception to Tremere disdain for gods.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm to which the commonest ghosts are linked.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Protection against magic; cannot be granted to mounts except by extending the Parma.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power measured in pawns; using it is dishonorable in Tremere duels.

name: Arcane connection
description: Magical link to a target.

name: Warping
description: Magical corruption, caused by using the Gate of Eurydice.

name: Regio
description: Magical layered area; many think the Gate of Eurydice is one.

name: Magical Focus
description: Specialty; Tremere magi cannot have foci other than certamen.

name: Necromancy
description: Magic of the dead practised by Tremere's ancestors and physicians.

name: Diabolism
description: Demon worship that Tremere watch for.

name: Longevity potion
description: Potion crafted by Tremere physicians.

name: Domus Magna
description: Chief covenant of a House.

name: Orbus
description: Outcast status declared by a Primus on one challenger.

name: Leap of Homecoming
description: Rego spell many Tremere use to retreat or deploy.

name: Seven League Stride
description: Riskier Rego transport spell used in desperation.

name: Weaver's Trap of Webs
description: Spell used as a guideline for whether a ghost escapes ethereal fisherman webs.

name: Perdo Mentem ritual (Sundering)
description: Likely ritual used inside Coeris to break Tremere's lieutenants' minds.

name: Ritual of Mount Lycaeon
description: Rumored ritual turning men into wolves for nine years.

name: Amber Eyes
description: Amber eyes given to over a thousand blinded Bulgars by a single Tremere ritual, inherited in Transylvania.

name: Mars incised with a square
description: House Tremere's symbol; the square represents a Roman road flagstone.

name: Voluntas vincit omnia
description: House Tremere motto, 'The Will conquers all', rarely used.

name: Butterfly and Two-Pronged Fork
description: Ancestral Tremere symbols of Aita's priesthood and Pluto.

name: Tines
description: Tremere term for a magus's preferred certamen arts.

name: Varus Disaster
description: Roman defeat killing 60,000 legionaries whose ghosts routed Diedne magi.

name: Duel for love
description: Certamen fought without a political issue, without vis.

name: Chess
description: Game with Old, Prima and Expedition variants popular among Tremere.

name: Auxiliaries
description: Mundane soldiers led by Tremere magi.

name: School of the Swordsman
description: Balanced certamen school of the Founder Tremere, reflected in the basic rules.

name: Andabatus
description: Blind Fighting certamen school trading Defense for Attack.

name: Bestiarius
description: School of Beasts used by Bjornaer, substituting Heartbeast for Finesse.

name: Bone-Biting
description: Diedne-derived certamen technique of self-injury for strength.

name: Charon (certamen trick)
description: Trick allowing two spells on an opponent at certamen's end.

name: Essedarius
description: Charioteer certamen techniques that intimidate foes.

name: Gladiatrix
description: School of the Swordswoman using a phantasmal chessboard.

name: Architects
description: Tremere Terram specialists maintaining fortifications, roads and bridges.

name: Artificers
description: Tremere makers of ritual objects, banners, sigils and secret items.

name: Assessor
description: Tremere urban diplomats, merchants or spies with the Gentle Gift.

name: Disputants
description: Tremere certamen specialists.

name: Master of Auxiliaries
description: Tremere magi who lead mundane soldiers with multicast spells.

name: Nauarchos
description: Tremere naval officers of the House fleet.

name: Physicians
description: Tremere healers and corporeal necromancers.

name: Scouts
description: Tremere explorers and information gatherers.

name: Signalers
description: Tremere communication and illusion specialists.

name: Legionary ghost
description: Ghost of a fallen Roman legionary, Magic Might 10 (Mentem).

name: Cataphract ghost
description: Ghost of an Eastern Empire mounted warrior, Magic Might 15, recruited by House Tremere.

name: Wili
description: Dark faerie ghosts of maidens dead on their wedding day, used by Tremere as assassins.

name: Moro
description: Vampires created from exposed children, shape of death's head moth.

name: Common White Wolves
description: Magical wolves descended from Tremere's familiar, serving the House.

name: Shadow Owl
description: Small magical raptor that blends and flies through solids.

name: Fire Hawk
description: Small magical raptor that ignites objects.

name: Griffin vulture
description: Large raptor of the Adriatic coast, popular as intelligence gatherer.

name: Griffin
description: Creature griffin vultures follow.

name: Ethereal Fisherman Spiders
description: Social spiders that trap and breed in ghosts; farmed for silk.

name: Ghost
description: Spirits of the dead, varied types.

name: Werewolf
description: Rumored servants of House Tremere.

name: Dark faeries
description: Faeries indistinguishable from solid Transylvanian ghosts.

name: Death's head moth
description: Moth believed to be a form of the moro.

name: Partially-fae horse
description: Horse breed of the Burning Acorn Vexillation, tolerating Gifted riders.

name: Genies
description: Spirits of Arabic wizards that carry them in flight.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Art referenced in the Tremere chapter.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Art referenced in the Tremere chapter.

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Art referenced in the Tremere chapter.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Art referenced in the Tremere chapter.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Art referenced in the Tremere chapter.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Art referenced in the Tremere chapter.

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Art referenced in the Tremere chapter.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Art referenced in the Tremere chapter.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Art referenced in the Tremere chapter.

name: Herbam
description: Hermetic Art referenced in the Tremere chapter.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Art referenced in the Tremere chapter.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Art referenced in the Tremere chapter.

name: Finesse
description: Ability referenced as used or valued by Tremere magi or creatures.

name: Penetration
description: Ability referenced as used or valued by Tremere magi or creatures.

name: Concentration
description: Ability referenced as used or valued by Tremere magi or creatures.

name: Intrigue
description: Ability referenced as used or valued by Tremere magi or creatures.

name: Bargain
description: Ability referenced as used or valued by Tremere magi or creatures.

name: Survival
description: Ability referenced as used or valued by Tremere magi or creatures.

name: Swim
description: Ability referenced as used or valued by Tremere magi or creatures.

name: Athletics
description: Ability referenced as used or valued by Tremere magi or creatures.

name: Profession (Soldier)
description: Ability referenced as used or valued by Tremere magi or creatures.

name: Hunt
